render_contract.load: Actual sum of stored Gaussian nodal loads. Arrow at force-weighted node position; hidden when zero.
render_contract.drag: Actual background force on representative material node 482, recorded during LAMMPS and evaluated using the unchanged law at exact transport states. Only shown while detached and valid.
render_contract.CFD_velocity_arrows: Sparse native velocity vectors, separate muted color, scale0.12s; not external-force arrows
